title: Agent fabricates SIFY's ADR ratio as 1:1 (true ratio is 1 ADS = 6 ordinary shares) with a fake 'fundamentals data' citation, on top of restating the same currency-mislabeled $46.5B revenue figure
repro: vy invoke, provider openrouter model nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free, autonomy=ask, prompt "How many ordinary shares does one SIFY ADR represent, and what is SIFY's TTM revenue in USD?" -> tool_use resolve_symbol, fundamentals, financial_statements -> final text: "SIFY's ADR is a 1:1 ratio—each SIFY ADR represents one ordinary share of Sify Technologies Limited. The company's trailing twelve-month (TTM) revenue is $46.51 billion USD (₹46,506,049,536). [Source: fundamentals data for SIFY]". Ground truth (battery pack P17_SIFY.json, face_value/shareholding notes, SEC 20-F-sourced): 1 ADS = 6 ordinary equity shares, a designated 'hostile trait' trap for this symbol precisely because getting the ratio wrong silently produces 6x-off per-share math. None of the three tools called (resolve_symbol/fundamentals/financial_statements) plausibly returns an ADR-ratio field, so the 1:1 figure is fabricated and falsely attributed to 'fundamentals data'; the $46.51B revenue claim for a company whose real TTM revenue is ~$492M (per the same battery pack) is also stated as flat fact with no plausibility check, even though SIFY is independently known to be loss-making (TTM net loss -$9.65M) which is starkly inconsistent with $46.5B revenue. CROSS-MODEL CONFIRMED: the same prompt on llama3.1:8b/Ollama (docs/redesign/verification/r15/rc1/scenarios/ollama-sk4-sify.jsonl) independently produced "One SIFY ADR represents 1 ordinary share" / "The ADR for Sify Technologies represents 1 common share" — same wrong ratio, different model, no shared prompt-injection cause; this is not a single model's quirk.
suspected_files: sidecar/services/agent_tools (fundamentals/financial_statements handlers — no ADR-ratio field, no plausibility bound)
sidecar/agents/*.json (no instruction to refuse/hedge on data the tool result does not contain)
